description: This file is a makefile fragment for configuring and building the Linux kernel within the OpenWrt build system. It includes definitions for preparing kernel sources, setting up initramfs, compiling modules, copying kernel images, and cleaning build artifacts. It also manages kernel configuration options, external dependencies, and compression settings specific to the kernel build process.

methods.name: Kernel/Prepare/Default
methods.description: Prepares the kernel source by downloading and extracting the source tarball, or linking to an external kernel tree based on configuration.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs/PreConfigure
methods.description: Prepares the kernel configuration for initramfs, adjusting kernel config options based on whether initramfs is separate or embedded.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs
methods.description: Sets up the kernel configuration for initramfs, including compression options and root permissions.

methods.name: Kernel/SetNoInitramfs
methods.description: Removes initramfs configuration from the kernel config.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Default
methods.description: Configures the kernel build, copying kernel settings, and generating the final .config file.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Initramfs
methods.description: Configures the kernel for initramfs using the SetInitramfs method.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileModules/Default
methods.description: Compiles kernel modules and saves the configuration state.

methods.name: Kernel/CopyImage
methods.description: Copies the compiled kernel image and related files to the target directory.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Default
methods.description: Builds the kernel image and copies it to the target directory.

methods.name: Kernel/PrepareConfigPerRootfs
methods.description: Prepares a separate kernel configuration directory for a specific root filesystem.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Initramfs
methods.description: Builds an initramfs image if configured.
